show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Chad Hutchinson – Professional Athlete to Professional Investor in Sports (EP.351)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Chad Hutchinson is a partner at Arctos Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Chad Hutchinson is a partner at Arctos Partners, a private equity firm best known as the leading minority owner of professional sports franchises. Chad was one of only seven athletes since 1970 to play in both Major League Baseball and the National Football League. After his sports career ended.

key_points.text: We discuss Chad's journey to two professional sports, mindset and framework for success, transition and career in finance.
Set all your assumptions about athletes and private equity managers aside as you listen to this incredible story of Chad's determination, humility, intelligence.
